chunks: And the narration had previously come from the saying of Abu Muhammad (peace be upon him) when he was given birth to:
The oppressors presumed that they would kill me to cut off this progeny. So how did they witness the might of Allah? And he named him Al-Mu'mal.

key_terms.الْمُؤْمَلُ: Al-Mu'mal (The one in whom hopes rest)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Hasan al-Askari say about the oppressors' attempt to cut off his progeny at the birth of the Mahdi?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* highlights the theological significance of Imam Hasan al-Askari naming his son Al-Mu'mal ('the Expected One'), emphasizing that the Umayyad and Abbasid oppressors failed to comprehend divine providence in preserving the Imamat. It underscores the Shia belief that the Imam's occultation is not a cessation of authority but a manifestation of Allah's power to protect the lineage against those who sought to extinguish it.
